description: 猫咪开口戒指（3D 打印款）完整说明 一、项目主要特点 猫咪轮廓首尾相呼应： 采用灵动的开口戒指结构，将猫咪坐立的背影剪影与卷曲的小尾巴巧妙地设置在开口两侧。佩戴时仿佛一只小猫温柔地环抱着你的手指，极具治愈感与趣味性。 极简几何剪影美学： 去掉了繁琐的面部与毛发纹理，仅保留小猫标志性的尖耳朵、圆润的身体弧度以及俏皮卷曲的尾巴尖。抽象的几何线条勾勒出高级的现代设计感，简约而不单调。 同心圆年轮纹理： 如图中所示，猫咪正面的微弧曲面完美契合了 3D 打印特有的“同心圆”等高线层纹。这些层纹如同树木年轮或指纹般自然延伸，为平整的金属感饰品增添了独特的艺术肌理。 贴合舒适的开口结构： 戒圈采用平滑加厚设计，内侧打磨平整，开口处预留了自然的过度空间，具有一定的微调延展性，大幅降低了圈号选错的风险。 二、适用场景 & 适配人群 适用场景 日常百搭萌系配饰： 时尚吸睛又不夸张，完美适配日系甜美风、极简通勤风以及日常休闲穿搭，是工位上极佳的治愈小单品。 猫奴/铲屎官专属标志： 作为爱猫人士的“身份认同”饰品，非常适合作为情侣款、闺蜜戒指或赠送给养猫朋友的趣味礼物。 桌面解压小软装： 取下摆放在键盘旁或办公桌上，其立体的猫咪背影本身就是一件极具温度的微缩极简雕塑。 适配人群 资深猫奴/宠物爱好者： 对猫咪元素毫无抵抗力，喜欢将萌宠元素融入生活细节的铲屎官们。 小众极简饰品收集者： 偏爱造型别致、线条流畅、具有几何现代感与艺术肌理首饰的潮流人士。 FDM 打印创客玩家： 喜欢挑战精致微缩小模型，享受随时随地根据手指尺寸“量体裁衣”定制打印的 DIY 达人。 三、3D 打印设置（0.4mm 标准喷嘴通用参数） 为了确保猫咪 ears（耳朵）与尾巴尖端的细节锐利，同时呈现出图中那种精致的同心圆表面肌理，建议参考以下切片设置： 层高（Layer Height）： 强烈建议使用 0.08mm - 0.12mm（较低的层高能让猫咪背部的同心圆纹理过渡得极其平滑，同时确保猫耳和尾巴尖不糊）。 墙数量 / 外轮廓（Walls / Perimeters）： 3 - 4 层（保证戒圈有足够的壁厚去承受微小的开口形变，避免佩戴时断裂）。 填充率（Infill）： 作为日常佩戴的戒指，建议设置为 100%（实心打印），这不仅能大幅提升戒圈强度，还能赋予其如同真正金属首饰般的沉甸分量感。 打印速度： 外部可见区域（Outer Wall）请务必降速至 25-35 mm/s，慢速打印是确保同心圆层纹清晰无瑕疵、猫耳尖端不拉丝的关键。 四、补充打印 & 组装建议 尺寸缩放与圈号参考： 标准首饰佩戴款（尺寸缩放参考常规戒指内径 18–22mm）： 测量佩戴手指的直径后，在切片软件中等比例缩放模型，使模型内圈直径（X/Y 轴内径）比实际手指直径大 0.3mm - 0.5mm。虽然是开口戒指，但预留少许公差能大幅提升佩戴舒适度。 桌面萌宠雕像（50–80mm）： 放大至手心大小，猫咪的背影和卷尾巴结构在放大后会呈现出极强的治愈系雕塑质感。 耗材与色彩推荐： 丝绸/蚕丝金属色（如图中效果）： 使用 蚕丝银（Silk Silver） 、 蚕丝白金 或 枪灰色 耗材，能打印出类似氧化哑光银首饰的高级金属光泽，极大提升质感。 哑光陶瓷色： 使用 哑光白（Matte White） 、 象牙黄 或 哑光黑 ，能消除塑料光泽，呈现出如白瓷或黑曜石般的抽象艺术感。 韧性强化提示： 虽然该戒指开口较宽，但如果需要微调圈号，建议使用 PLA+（高韧性 PLA） 或 PETG 耗材打印，这能防止在手动撑开或捏紧戒圈时发生脆性断裂。 边缘倒角与打磨： 打印完成后，建议用 1000 目以上的细砂纸将戒指内圈与开口处（特别是尾巴尖与猫耳朵边缘）轻轻打磨倒角，确保佩戴时不卡手、不刮皮肤。

This project is a premium parametric Cotton Pad Dispenser (Porta Algodão Dispensador) with a vertical U-shaped front slot. It allows you to load a stack of circular cotton pads from the top and easily pull pads out one-by-one from the bottom. Fully parametric in OpenSCAD, it features three standard capacities, optional screw-on lid configuration, and deep aesthetic customization. --- UNLIMITED CUSTOMIZATION --- With over 30 texture patterns and adjustable scales, this project offers hundreds of unique combinations for you to create an exclusive dispenser. --- PARAMETER GUIDE --- 1. Size & Capacity - Size Selection: Choose between three height capacities: - Small (P): Height 80mm (Holds approx. 20 cotton pads) - Medium (M): Height 120mm (Holds approx. 35 cotton pads) - Large (G): Height 160mm (Holds approx. 50 cotton pads) - Has_Lid: Option to include a screw-on lid. - Enabled (Yes): Adds a top thread to the base and exports the lid. - Disabled (No): Removes threads entirely, leaving a clean open-top dispenser with a smooth, rounded upper rim. 2. Dispenser Slot Settings - Cutout Width: Controls the width of the vertical dispensing slot (Default: 35mm). It is optimized to be wide enough for your fingers to easily pull a pad out, but narrow enough to keep the pads stacked securely inside. - Bottom Lip: Height of the bottom retaining wall that supports the stack (Default: 8mm). 3. Aesthetics and Texture - Surface Pattern: Applies geometric textures in high/low relief to the outer face (Default: Grid Diagonal). - Pattern Depth: Controls how pronounced the texture is (recommended: 0.6mm). - Pattern Scale: Adjusts the size of the texture tiles. Small variations in this scale dramatically transform the visual effect, essentially creating entirely new textures from a single base pattern. You can fine-tune the look from bold geometric shapes to fine, intricate details. Scale effects on the same pattern - Text Bands: Show customized text at the top (Default: "COTTON"). - Logo Patch: Creates a smooth, centralized area on the base for logos or custom labeling. --- TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS & PRINTING --- - Support-Free Design: Both the dispenser base and the lid print completely without supports. The bottom of the U-slot is a semi-circle that prints cleanly in mid-air, and the inside has straight 62.0mm cylinder walls to prevent soft cotton pads from catching or tearing. - Smart Lidless Finishes: When printing without a lid, the top edge of the dispenser is automatically detailed with a smooth, 1.0mm double-rounded rim (both inner and outer lips). This ensures that cotton pads don't snag when loading and the top is completely safe and pleasant to touch. - Perfect Thread Synchronization: When the lid is enabled, the metric threading system includes a hardcoded thread phase (angular offset). This guarantees that when you fully tighten the lid, the texture patterns on the lid and the base align flawlessly, even with the vertical slot cutout. --- RECOMMENDED PRINT SETTINGS (Bambu Studio / OrcaSlicer) --- RECOMMENDED PRINT SETTINGS (Bambu Studio / OrcaSlicer) --- - Layer Height: 0.16mm (Optimal) - Wall Generator: Arachne (Required for sharp texture details) - Line Width: 0.6mm (Outer & Inner walls) - Infill: 10 Gyroid or Cross Hatch - Speed: 100 mm/s (Outer & Inner walls for premium finish) - Supports: No supports needed! description: 猫妖鳞片面具（3D 打印款）完整说明 一: 项目主要特点 奇幻生物美学： 巧妙融合了猫科动物的灵动耳廓与东方龙/奇幻野兽的鳞片元素，整体呈现出一种神秘、野性且优雅的妖精面具造型，极具视觉张力。 层叠复杂的鳞片肌理： 面具表面由成百上千片细腻的仿生鱼鳞/龙鳞紧密交织而成，从眉心向两侧呈放射状铺开，层次分明，立体感极强。 锐利夸张的边缘剪影： 耳朵外缘与面具轮廓带有大量尖锐、带有朋克风格的刺状装饰，配合明艳的红色，散发出浓郁的暗黑奇幻与魔幻现实主义色彩。 流线贴合的面部弧度： 整体呈现自然的内凹弧面，完美契合人脸轮廓，眼部开孔宽敞，兼顾了造型的艺术感与实际佩戴的视野。 二: 适用场景 & 适配人群 适用场景 化装舞会与万圣节派对： 作为惊艳全场的独立面部饰品，完美融入哥特风、精灵风、赛博巫术或奇幻角色扮演（Cosplay）的装扮中。 主题摄影与潮玩陈列： 不仅能佩戴，其极具雕塑感的造型也非常适合作为摄影道具，或挂在墙面上作为独特的现代艺术墙饰。 个性化节日伴手礼： 送给喜欢奇幻文学、桌游跑团或动漫展爱好者的绝佳硬核礼物。 适配人群 Cosplay 与奇幻爱好者： 钟情于魔幻、精灵、龙族等神秘生物设定，热衷于打造独特个性造型的玩家。 暗黑美学与先锋时尚达人： 偏爱夸张、张扬、具有强烈视觉符号感配饰的潮流人士。 3D 打印造型发烧友： 喜欢高难度复杂曲面打印、享受大体积精细模型制作挑战的创客玩家。 三: 3D 打印设置（0.4mm 标准喷嘴通用参数） 为了完美还原成百上千片细密鳞片与边缘利刺的锐利度，建议参考以下极限精度切片参数（ 注：由于面具属于大面积贴脸薄壁结构，强烈建议适当调慢速度 ）： 层高（Layer Height）： 推荐设置为 0.12mm - 0.16mm。兼顾打印效率与鳞片表面的细腻层纹表现。 墙数量 / 外轮廓（Walls / Perimeters）： 3 - 4 层。多层外墙能彻底保证密集的鳞片结构与边缘尖刺坚固不易折断。 填充率（Infill）： 15% - 20%（推荐使用 网格 Grid 或 陀螺仪 Gyroid 填充），既能保持面具整体的轻量化（佩戴不压鼻梁），又能提供足够的结构强度。 打印速度： 外部可见区域（Outer Wall）必须严格降速至 30-40 mm/s。由于面具表面有大量向外延伸的鳞片和倒刺，慢速能有效防止冷却不足导致的拉丝和变形。 四: 补充打印 & 组装建议 尺寸缩放与佩戴参考： 真人佩戴款（150-180mm 宽度）： 打印前建议使用卡尺测量自己双颊之间的最大宽度，在切片软件中对 X/Y 轴进行等比例微调，确保眼孔位置与自己的瞳距相匹配。 微缩收藏/摆件款（80-100mm）： 缩小尺寸后可搭配支架摆在桌面上作为精致的工艺品。 耗材与色彩推荐： 烈焰妖精风（如图中效果）： 使用 亮红色（Red） 、 金属赤红 或 熔岩橙 PLA 耗材，能瞬间突显出野兽与妖精的张扬与热烈。 暗夜精灵风： 使用 哑光黑 、 深紫色 或 丝绸暗金 ，后期可以通过局部干扫银色或金色颜料，让鳞片的层次感瞬间爆发，呈现出类似中世纪魔器的高级质感。 佩戴固定小贴士： 面具两侧边缘通常预留有穿线孔或微小凹槽，建议使用黑色松紧带或皮革绳穿过两侧固定；若需要直接贴脸，也可以在面具内侧贴上一层薄海绵条或防滑硅胶垫，能大幅提升长时间佩戴的舒适度。

Instructions 🛠️👕 Download the model and open it in Bambu Studio 💻 Print the model using the recommended settings and carefully remove it from the build plate. ⚠️ Handle with care — the model is extremely thin (approximately 0.3 mm) and may tear or deform if bent too aggressively. Set your iron to a very high temperature (almost maximum heat, without steam) 🔥 Allow the iron to fully preheat before starting. Position the printed model on the desired area of the T-shirt and cover it with baking/parchment paper 📄 Apply firm pressure with the preheated iron for 15–20 seconds. description: 优雅马蹄莲/花瓣美学戒指（3D 打印款）完整说明 一: 项目主要特点 自然植物美学： 戒指正面以盛开的马蹄莲（或优雅花瓣）为灵感核心，层叠交错的花瓣自然包裹，线条优美流畅，散发着清新、高雅且浪漫的自然气息。 精致的同心圆层纹理： 如图中展示的那样，纯白色的花瓣表面与戒圈上呈现出极其细腻、宛如天然年轮或水波纹般的等高线层纹，为简约的花卉造型增添了独特的现代工艺质感。 一体化流线戒圈： 戒圈由花茎与花托部分自然向下延伸过渡，整体结构浑然天成，无需任何后期拼接，一次性3D打印成型。 纯净的微缩雕塑感： 采用纯白色的视觉呈现，既像一件精美的艺术微雕，又兼具现代极简主义首饰的高级时尚感。 二: 适用场景 & 适配人群 适用场景 日常清新/法式穿搭配饰： 作为指尖的点睛之笔，完美适配法式优雅、森系清新或日常休闲的穿搭风格，低调中透着精致。 浪漫节日与纪念日礼物： 寓意纯洁与美好，非常适合作为情人节、生日或纪念日送给伴侣、闺蜜的浪漫小礼物。 桌面艺术陈列： 不佩戴时，将其摆放在梳妆台或首饰架上，其优美的花朵造型本身就是一件极具观赏价值的桌面小品。 适配人群 自然与花卉元素爱好者： 偏爱植物、花朵主题，钟情于温润柔和设计风格的首饰佩戴者。 极简美学饰品控： 喜欢线条流畅、造型不浮夸且带有独特3D打印肌理感的小众设计配饰达人。 3D 打印创客玩家： 喜欢打印精致微缩有机曲面、热衷于尝试不同纯色或丝绸质感耗材的DIY爱好者。 三: 3D 打印设置（0.4mm 标准喷嘴通用参数） 为了完美呈现马蹄莲花瓣边缘的轻薄感以及表面细腻的同心圆层纹，建议参考以下切片参数： 层高（Layer Height）： 推荐设置为 0.08mm - 0.12mm。较细的层高能让花瓣交叠处的弧度极其平滑，彻底消除阶梯感。 墙数量 / 外轮廓（Walls / Perimeters）： 3 - 4 层。多层外墙能有效保证戒圈及外翻花瓣的结构强度，防止日常佩戴时受力断裂。 填充率（Infill）： 推荐设置为 100%（实心打印）。实心填充能带来更好的手感重量，并确保花瓣与戒圈连接处的绝对牢固。 打印速度： 外部可见区域（Outer Wall）建议降速至 30-40 mm/s。慢速打印是保证花瓣边缘平整、表面纹理清晰均匀的关键。 四: 补充打印 & 组装建议 尺寸缩放与佩戴参考： 标准首饰佩戴款（按手指内径缩放）： 测量佩戴手指的直径后，在切片软件中等比例缩放模型内径，建议比实际手指直径大 0.3mm - 0.5mm，确保佩戴顺畅舒适。 桌面摆件收藏款（50-70mm）： 放大尺寸后可以作为精致的桌面花朵雕塑或小型戒指展示座。 耗材与色彩推荐： 纯白骨瓷风（如图中效果）： 使用 哑光白（Matte White）或象牙白 PLA 耗材，呈现出类似高级陶瓷或石膏雕塑的纯净质感。 浪漫彩金/珍珠风： 推荐使用丝绸白金（Silk White/Pearl）耗材，打印出的花瓣自带珍珠般的柔和光泽，极其惊艳。 佩戴舒适度优化： 打印完成后，建议用 800 目以上的细砂纸将戒指内圈稍微打磨光滑，确保贴合皮肤时温润舒适、不刮手。

description: Turn your favorite design into a unique 3D T-shirt 👕🖨️ These thin and flexible 3D prints are designed to be heat-transferred directly onto fabric using a household iron. The result is a durable and eye-catching 3D design that combines modern 3D printing technology with fashion. Instructions 🛠️👕 Download the model and open it in Bambu Studio 💻 Print the model using the recommended settings and carefully remove it from the build plate. ⚠️ Handle with care — the model is extremely thin (approximately 0.3 mm) and may tear or deform if bent too aggressively. Prepare your ironing area: Place the T-shirt on an ironing board or a flat heat-resistant surface. Set your iron to a very high temperature (almost maximum heat, without steam) 🔥 Allow the iron to fully preheat before starting. Position the printed model on the desired area of the T-shirt and cover it with baking/parchment paper 📄 Apply firm pressure with the preheated iron for 15–20 seconds. For larger designs, move the iron slowly and evenly to ensure the entire model receives sufficient heat. Maintain consistent pressure throughout the process. ⏱️ Allow the area to cool for a few seconds, then carefully remove the paper. ✅ The model should remain attached to the fabric while the paper lifts away easily. (Optional) Turn the T-shirt inside out and iron the reverse side of the applied design for an additional 5–10 seconds to improve adhesion. 👕✨ Important ⚠️ Always use the iron at a very high temperature (near maximum setting) and with the steam function turned off. Insufficient heat or pressure may result in poor adhesion to the fabric. Test on a small area first if using delicate or heat-sensitive fabrics. Care Instructions 🧼 Wash garments at temperatures not exceeding 50°C (122°F). Turn the T-shirt inside out before washing whenever possible. Avoid bleach and aggressive washing programs. Do not tumble dry at high temperatures. ⚠️ Washing or drying at excessive temperatures may cause the 3D print to loosen or peel from the fabric over time.

description: Turn your favorite design into a unique 3D T-shirt 👕🖨️ These thin and flexible 3D prints are designed to be heat-transferred directly onto fabric using a household iron. Instructions 🛠️👕 Download the model and open it in Bambu Studio 💻 Print the model using the recommended settings and carefully remove it from the build plate. ⚠️ Handle with care — the model is extremely thin (approximately 0.3 mm) and may tear or deform if bent too aggressively. Prepare your ironing area: Place the T-shirt on an ironing board or a flat heat-resistant surface. Set your iron to a very high temperature (almost maximum heat, without steam) 🔥 Allow the iron to fully preheat before starting. Position the printed model on the desired area of the T-shirt and cover it with baking/parchment paper 📄 Apply firm pressure with the preheated iron for 15–20 seconds. For larger designs, move the iron slowly and evenly to ensure the entire model receives sufficient heat. Maintain consistent pressure throughout the process. ⏱️ Allow the area to cool for a few seconds, then carefully remove the paper. ✅ The model should remain attached to the fabric while the paper lifts away easily. (Optional) Turn the T-shirt inside out and iron the reverse side of the applied design for an additional 5–10 seconds to improve adhesion. 👕✨ Important ⚠️ Always use the iron at a very high temperature (near maximum setting) and with the steam function turned off. Insufficient heat or pressure may result in poor adhesion to the fabric. Test on a small area first if using delicate or heat-sensitive fabrics. Care Instructions 🧼 Wash garments at temperatures not exceeding 50°C (122°F). Turn the T-shirt inside out before washing whenever possible. Avoid bleach and aggressive washing programs. For daily wear, the hollow design softens the crown’s bold aura; at art salons and themed photoshoots, its distinctive gothic hollow architecture stands out from mass-produced generic jewellery. Stripped of the ostentation of metal crowns, the plain white material shifts focus entirely to structural and sculptural beauty, ideal for lovers of architectural design, gothic heritage and expressive wearable art. Wear it alone to showcase quiet dominance, or stack alongside wing and marine-series rings to create striking contrast between tough and soft aesthetics. The world endlessly chases ceremonial coronation, yet many overlook the throne within. Shaped as a hollow gothic crown, Crown Veil reminds you not to crave validation from others. When you uphold your inner order, you are eternally crowned. External fame will eventually turn to dust, but the strength you grant yourself lasts forever.

description: It’s very easy to apply. Just follow these steps: Print: Use the template I’ve already prepared. description: 极简灵狐手镯（3D 打印款）完整说明 一、项目主要特点 首尾呼应的环绕美学： 采用经典的 C 型开口手镯形态，巧妙地将狐狸的头部与蓬松的尾巴分别置于手镯的两端。佩戴时宛如一只灵动的白狐优雅地缠绕在腕间，极具动态美感与自然生机。 极简抽象雕塑质感： 摒弃了繁琐的毛发细节，提取狐狸最迷人的几何轮廓。硬朗的尖耳、修长的吻部与圆润流畅的尾巴形成鲜明对比，整体呈现出类似现代白瓷或骨雕的极简高级感。 灵动的微弹开口设计： 借助 3D 打印材料的物理特性与 C 型结构，手镯天然具备一定的韧性与微弹空间，既保证了佩戴的便捷性，又能很好地贴合不同粗细的手腕。 独特的层纹光影： 表面细腻均匀的 3D 打印层纹非但没有成为瑕疵，反而顺着手镯的弧度生长，形成了一种类似原生木纹或精细手工拉丝的特殊肌理，在侧光下极具艺术气息。 二、适用场景 & 适配人群 适用场景 极简/森系穿搭配饰： 作为日常出街的点睛之笔，完美适配极简风（Normcore）、森系复古风或新中式禅意穿搭，低调却极其吸睛。 精致的桌面首饰陈列： 不佩戴时，可将其挂在首饰架上，或直接立于桌面，本身就是一件极具欣赏价值的微缩动物雕塑。 独特的心意伴手礼： 狐狸常被赋予“灵智”与“守护”的寓意，作为礼物送给闺蜜或伴侣，既别致又充满浪漫色彩。 适配人群 小众设计首饰控： 厌倦了市面上千篇一律的金属手镯，追求有温度、有故事感、极简设计语言的饰品爱好者。 自然与动物爱好者： 对狐狸等灵性动物元素情有独钟的文艺青年。 3D 打印实用派： 喜欢将 3D 打印技术应用于日常生活穿搭，享受“所想即所得、随时定制尺寸”乐趣的创客玩家。 三、3D 打印设置（0.4mm 标准喷嘴通用参数） 为了确保手镯具备足够的结构强度（防止佩戴时断裂），同时完美展现狐狸五官的锐利感，建议参考以下切片参数： 层高（Layer Height）： 推荐使用 0.12mm - 0.16mm。较低的层高能够让狐狸尾巴的圆弧过渡更加顺滑，同时确保狐狸鼻尖和眼睛部位的细节不丢失。 墙数量 / 外轮廓（Walls / Perimeters）： 强烈建议设置为 4 - 5 层。对于手镯类受力模型，增加外墙厚度是提升整体抗折断韧性的最有效方法。 填充率（Infill）： 必须设置为 100%（实心打印）。开口手镯在穿脱时会产生向外撑开的应力，实心打印能赋予其最大的结构刚性与安全性。 打印速度： 外部可见区域（Outer Wall）建议降速至 30-40 mm/s，慢速打印能让狐狸头部的悬空面（如下巴处）成型更加完美，减少打磨工作量。 四、补充打印 & 组装建议 尺寸缩放与测量参考： 定制缩放： 打印前，请务必使用软尺或游标卡尺测量佩戴者手腕侧面（最窄处）的宽度。在切片软件中等比例缩放模型，使手镯开口的距离略小于手腕最窄宽度，手镯内径的宽度略大于手腕正面宽度即可。 耗材推荐（核心关键）： 材质选择： 由于手镯需要被微微撑开才能佩戴， 极其不建议使用普通脆性 PLA （很容易在戴上的瞬间“啪”地断裂）。强烈建议使用 PETG 、 ABS 或 PLA+（高韧性 PLA） 耗材，它们具有绝佳的弹性恢复力，能承受日常的穿脱形变。 色彩美学： 推荐 哑光白（Matte White） 、象牙白（Ivory） 展现骨雕质感；或者使用 仿木耗材（Wood PLA）打印后轻轻打磨，呈现出极其逼真的手工木雕手镯效果。 佩戴小贴士： 正确的佩戴方式是将手腕侧过来（手腕最窄的方向），将手镯开口对准手腕侧面滑入，然后再旋转至手腕正面，这样可以最大限度减少对手镯的强行拉扯。 边缘打磨： 打印完成后，建议使用 800 目 - 1000 目的细砂纸，将手镯内圈与皮肤接触的边缘进行轻轻打磨倒角，确保佩戴时极致亲肤、不刮手。

description: Choco Snap – Clicky Chocolate Fidget Keychain A satisfying chocolate-shaped fidget keychain you can print in about an hour. 🍫 Choco Snap is a compact clicky fidget designed around three things: quick printing, low filament usage, and a satisfying mechanical snap. The three chocolate sections move independently, while a piece cut from a steel retractable tape measure blade creates the characteristic clicky action. Add a ball chain and Choco Snap becomes a compact fidget keychain you can carry on your bag, pouch, backpack, or keys. 🎥 Assembly Guide Please watch the assembly guide before preparing the steel tape measure piece or assembling the model. The video shows the complete assembly process, including the placement and orientation of the internal components. Watch the Choco Snap Assembly Guide ✨ Features 🍫 Chocolate-inspired design 🖱️ Satisfying mechanical click and snap ⏱️ Around 1 hour print time 🧵 Low filament usage 🔑 Compact keychain size 🛠️ Simple assembly 🎨 Easy to customize with different colors ♻️ Uses small pieces of 1.75 mm filament as hinge pins 🖨️ Printing Choco Snap was designed to be a quick and lightweight project that doesn't require a large amount of filament. PLA works well for the printed body. Because the model is small, it's a great project when you want something fun and functional without waiting several hours for a print. Actual print time and filament usage may vary depending on: Printer Print profile Layer height Print speed Filament Other slicer settings With an appropriate profile, the complete set of printed parts can be produced in approximately 1 hour . 🔧 Additional Parts Needed In addition to the printed parts, you will need: A piece cut from a steel retractable tape measure blade 1.75 mm filament for the hinge pins A ball chain or another keychain attachment, if desired The steel tape measure piece is a key part of the clicking mechanism and is required for the intended snap action. ⚙️ Important – Click Mechanism The key component of Choco Snap is the steel tape measure piece installed inside the model. Cut a piece from a steel retractable tape measure blade to approximately: 50 mm long × 10–11 mm wide The natural curved shape and elasticity of the steel tape are used to create Choco Snap's characteristic snap movement and clicky feel when the chocolate sections are pressed. After cutting the tape to size, install it inside the printed parts as shown in the assembly guide. The position and orientation of the steel tape piece are important for proper operation. If the click doesn't feel right after assembly, check the placement and orientation of the steel tape first. ⚠️ Cutting the Steel Tape Measure Please take care when preparing the steel tape measure piece. The cut edges of a tape measure blade can be sharp. When cutting it: Use appropriate cutting tools Wear eye protection Keep your hands away from the cutting area Smooth or deburr sharp edges before assembly Do not install the piece while sharp burrs remain on the cut edges. 🔩 Hinge Assembly The three chocolate sections are connected using short pieces of 1.75 mm filament as hinge pins. Cut the filament to the required length and insert it through the hinge holes to connect the sections. Using filament as the hinge pins keeps the assembly simple and eliminates the need for additional metal pins or screws. Basic Assembly Prepare the three printed chocolate sections. Connect the sections using 1.75 mm filament as hinge pins. Install the prepared steel tape measure piece. Check that each section moves smoothly. Test the snapping action. Attach a ball chain if you want to use Choco Snap as a keychain. For the exact assembly method, refer to the video at the top of this page. 🍫 Color Ideas Try printing Choco Snap in different “flavors”: Milk Chocolate Brown White Chocolate Matcha Green Strawberry Pink Dark Chocolate Caramel Or create your own flavor! Different filament colors can completely change the look of the model. If you print one, I'd love to see your color combination! 📌 Notes This model is a fidget/keychain and is not food . The click feel and sound may vary slightly depending on the filament, print tolerances, and steel tape measure piece. Make sure all sharp metal edges are properly smoothed before use. Actual print time may vary depending on your printer and print profile.

It fuses classical court aesthetics with life-and-death imagery for niche retro luxury lovers. A realistic carved skull serves as focal point, with delicate bone texture and neat teeth delivering solemn medieval religious vibes. Intricate European scroll vines twist all around the skull, with curved leaves and clear veins converging into a bud top. Inspired by medieval church reliefs, dense carvings follow Chinese blank composition rules, rich yet orderly. Proper hollowing balances grandeur and lightness. Crafted with time-honored Dehua ivory white porcelain with triple glazing and double high-temperature firing, the porcelain boasts warm jade-like creamy tone, soft and mild without harsh grey or stark whiteness. The glossy glaze appears subtle in dim light and translucent under bright light, fully highlighting premium porcelain texture. The band features layered carving: outer surface covered with tiny twig patterns while inner wall stays smooth. All raised carving edges are rounded to prevent snags and scratches for safe daily wear. Drawing inspiration from medieval cemetery reliefs and gothic church stonework, the skull embodies meditation on eternal life, while winding vines symbolize samsara of life and death. description: Give your lost item a way back home FoundIt Halo is a customizable lost-and-found tag designed for backpacks, suitcases and bags. Its simple, universal shape makes it suitable for everyday use, while the QR code connects the finder with the owner through the free FoundIt service. Unlike a traditional tag with a phone number or home address printed on it, FoundIt does not expose the owner’s personal details to everyone nearby. It provides a private way to recover lost belongings without publicly displaying the owner’s or finder’s contact information. How FoundIt works Each tag uses its own individual QR code generated on foundit.cc . When someone finds your item, they can scan the QR code and open a contact form connected to your tag. The finder can: send a message to the owner, attach a photo of the found item, share the exact location where the item is located, optionally provide an email address to enable two-way communication. If the finder confirms their email address, both sides can continue the conversation through FoundIt without revealing their email addresses to each other. The finder does not need to create an account or install an app. Create your own tag FoundIt is completely free and allows each account to create up to 20 tags for personal 3D printing. Before printing: Create a free account at foundit.cc/register . Generate a free tag code. Enter the code in the MakerLab Customizer. Check that the generated QR code opens the correct tag page. Generate and print the model. The visible tag number and the QR code must always use the same FoundIt code. Customization options The model can be adjusted directly in the customizer. You can change: the overall tag size, the position of the text, the attachment-hole style, the edge-rounding style, the printing configuration for the detailed face. The simple shape was designed to remain practical and versatile without limiting the tag to one specific type of item. Example file The included example model uses the tag number: PRM-N2E This is an active public demonstration tag connected to FoundIt. You are welcome to scan it and send a test message to see how the service works. For your own printed tag, replace PRM-N2E with a code generated in your FoundIt account. Recommended print settings Material: PETG Nozzle: 0.4 mm Layer height: 0.2 mm Infill: 60% The model was printed and tested on a Bambu Lab P2S. The printed QR code scanned correctly without any problems. Good contrast between the QR code and the base is strongly recommended. Black and white usually provide the most reliable result. Important note FoundIt is not a GPS tracker and does not actively track the location of your item. It cannot prevent theft or guarantee that a lost item will be returned. It provides a simple and private way for an honest finder to contact the owner after finding the tagged item.

description: Turn your favorite design into a unique 3D T-shirt 👕🖨️ These thin and flexible 3D prints are designed to be heat-transferred directly onto fabric using a household iron. Instructions 🛠️👕 Download the model and open it in Bambu Studio 💻 Print the model using the recommended settings and carefully remove it from the build plate. ⚠️ Handle with care — the model is extremely thin (approximately 0.3 mm) and may tear or deform if bent too aggressively. Prepare your ironing area: Place the T-shirt on an ironing board or a flat heat-resistant surface. Set your iron to a very high temperature (almost maximum heat, without steam) 🔥 Allow the iron to fully preheat before starting. Position the printed model on the desired area of the T-shirt and cover it with baking/parchment paper 📄 Apply firm pressure with the preheated iron for 15–20 seconds. For larger designs, move the iron slowly and evenly to ensure the entire model receives sufficient heat. Maintain consistent pressure throughout the process. ⏱️ Allow the area to cool for a few seconds, then carefully remove the paper. ✅ The model should remain attached to the fabric while the paper lifts away easily. (Optional) Turn the T-shirt inside out and iron the reverse side of the applied design for an additional 5–10 seconds to improve adhesion. 👕✨ Important ⚠️ Always use the iron at a very high temperature (near maximum setting) and with the steam function turned off. Insufficient heat or pressure may result in poor adhesion to the fabric. Test on a small area first if using delicate or heat-sensitive fabrics. Care Instructions 🧼 Wash garments at temperatures not exceeding 50°C (122°F). Turn the T-shirt inside out before washing whenever possible. Avoid bleach and aggressive washing programs. description: 空洞骑士/深渊小主角浮雕戒指（3D 打印款）完整说明 一: 项目主要特点 经典游戏美学致敬： 戒指正面高度还原了知名独立游戏《空洞骑士》（Hollow Knight）中主角标志性的无面面具、弯曲尖角以及破损的斗篷流苏，带有一股独特的暗黑童话与银河恶魔城游戏风情。 精美的藤蔓浮雕背景： 戒圈两侧延伸出细腻对称的哥特风藤蔓与卷草纹浮雕，将简洁的Q版角色与华丽的古典巴洛ก风格完美结合，极具艺术观赏性。 纯净的白色雕塑质感： 如图中展示的那样，通过纯白色的打印材质呈现出类似高级陶瓷或微缩石膏雕塑的纯粹质感，让游戏情怀与现代简约设计完美碰撞。 宽版一体化戒圈： 采用宽边加厚的一体成型结构，正面角色与两侧藤蔓自然过渡包裹，整体牢固且兼具强烈的手工大作存在感。 二: 适用场景 & 适配人群 适用场景 游戏玩家日常穿搭： 作为极具极客情怀与辨识度的指尖单品，低调融入日常穿搭，随时展露资深玩家身份。 桌面手办与游戏周边陈列： 不仅能佩戴，将其摆放在显示器旁或游戏手柄旁边，本身就是一个极其精致的微型游戏纪念雕像。 游戏爱好者的心意礼物： 送给热爱《空洞骑士》、独立游戏或魂系作品的朋友，是一份充满共同回忆与惊喜的硬核小礼物。 适配人群 独立游戏发烧友： 钟情于《空洞骑士》世界观、美术风格以及“小骑士”孤勇冒险精神的硬核玩家。 ACG 潮流饰品收集者： 偏爱游戏动漫衍生品、喜欢将二次元文化融入日常配饰的年轻一代。 3D 打印模型爱好者： 喜欢打印精致小比例游戏角色、热衷于后期上色或直接收藏纯白极简风模型的创客。 三: 3D 打印设置（0.4mm 标准喷嘴通用参数） 为了确保小骑士标志性的大眼睛轮廓、圆角头盔以及两侧极其细密的藤蔓浮雕纹理清晰锐利，建议参考以下切片参数： 层高（Layer Height）： 推荐设置为 0.08mm - 0.12mm。极细的层高能彻底消除小骑士头顶和眼窝处的台阶纹，让面具表面如陶瓷般光滑。 墙数量 / 外轮廓（Walls / Perimeters）： 3 - 4 层。多层外墙能有效增强戒圈整体强度，防止面具和两侧浮雕在佩戴时发生断裂。 填充率（Infill）： 推荐设置为 100%（实心打印）。作为宽版戒指，实心填充能带来完美的沉甸手感，并提供最高的抗压结构强度。 打印速度： 外部可见区域（Outer Wall）建议降速至 30-40 mm/s。较慢的打印速度能保证头盔顶部的圆弧过度平滑，且防止藤蔓细节处发生拉丝。 四: 补充打印 & 组装建议 尺寸缩放与佩戴参考： 标准首饰佩戴款（按手指内径缩放）： 测量佩戴手指的直径后，在切片软件中等比例缩放模型内径，建议比实际手指直径大 0.5mm 左右（由于是宽版戒指，适当留出余量可避免卡手）。 桌面摆件收藏款（60-80mm）： 放大尺寸后可以作为独立的桌面摆件，小骑士的眼神和斗篷细节会更加震撼。 耗材与色彩推荐： 纯白雕塑风（如图中效果）： 使用 哑光白（Matte White） PLA 耗材，呈现高级的艺术画廊雕塑感。 深渊做旧风： 推荐使用 黑色（Black）或深灰色 耗材打印，随后用稀释的白色颜料进行干扫（Dry Brush），能瞬间让小骑士头盔的边缘和藤蔓纹理立体感爆棚，完美还原游戏深渊的氛围。 佩戴舒适度优化： 打印完成后，建议用 800 目以上的细砂纸将戒指内圈稍微打磨光滑，以确保长时间佩戴时的舒适、不刮手。

description: 霜鹿・凝瑶（Frost Stag・Frosted Jade） 霜鹿・凝瑶白瓷戒指以德化传世羊脂白瓷为基底，融汇北欧森林神话与欧式复古浮雕工艺，将山林灵鹿的清逸雅致凝于指尖方寸，打造兼具仙气、贵气与东方瓷韵的轻奢艺术首饰。戒面以对称双鹿角作为视觉主体，匠人手工复刻天然鹿角交错嶙峋的原生肌理，枝杈起伏错落、纹理深浅自然，棱角柔和不尖锐，兼具山野野性与雕琢精致感。鹿角下方缠绕繁复复古卷草藤蔓，花叶卷曲婉转，镂空纹路层层交织，复刻巴洛克古典雕花美学，疏密排布遵循美学留白，繁复却不拥挤，通透镂空消解大面积雕花的厚重沉闷。戒面正中心镶嵌一颗同瓷椭圆形弧面主石，瓷面温润莹亮，哑光瓷雕与亮面宝石瓷形成明暗层次，光线流转时光影错落，立体感拉满。 整件戒指采用 1300℃高温多次煅烧德化白瓷，瓷胎致密紧实，硬度远超银、铜等金属，耐磨抗磕碰，防水防汗，日常洗手、沐浴无需摘下，长年佩戴依旧莹白如新，不会出现氧化发黑、镀层脱落等问题。戒圈内壁全弧度手工打磨，圆润顺滑贴合指面，雕花凸起边缘全部做圆角钝化处理，不会勾丝刮肤，兼顾华丽外观与日常佩戴舒适感。 设计灵感源自月下灵鹿栖于林间的浪漫意象，鹿角象征自由、祥瑞与生命力，中心瓷石代表皎洁月光，寓意心怀澄澈、自在坦荡，前路顺遂安然。风格适配场景多元，女性搭配汉服、洛丽塔、复古洋装、温柔针织衫，灵动优雅氛围感拉满；男性搭配休闲西装、简约衬衫、国风唐装，清冷矜贵，自带疏离高级感。市面上同类鹿角首饰多以金属量产，纹路僵硬冰冷，而本款依托手工瓷雕，每一处枝杈、藤蔓都带有独一无二的手工细节，不存在两枚完全相同的戒指，收藏属性出众。整件作品摒弃彩宝堆砌，依靠白瓷材质本身的质感与雕刻线条撑起高级感，清冷温柔、复古大气兼容，既可以作为日常穿搭的点睛配饰，也适合作为纪念日、生日的馈赠好物，把山野月色与灵鹿诗意永久封存，小众耐看，不落俗套。 Frost Stag · Frosted Jade white porcelain ring is crafted from time-honored Dehua mutton-fat white porcelain, blending Nordic forest mythology with European retro relief craftsmanship. It condenses the elegant grace of forest deer into wearable fingertip art, combining ethereal charm, noble texture and oriental porcelain charm. Symmetrical antlers dominate the front of the ring. Craftsmen hand-carve lifelike rugged textures of natural antlers with uneven branches and natural grain. Soft edges balance wild vitality and delicate carving. Twisted retro scroll vines wind beneath antlers. Layered hollow carvings inherit Baroque aesthetics with reasonable density layout. Hollow spaces reduce heaviness brought by dense patterns. An oval cabochon porcelain stone is embedded at the center. Matte carved porcelain contrasts with glossy smooth porcelain stone, building rich light and shadow layers as light moves. Fired repeatedly at 1300℃, high-density Dehua porcelain boasts higher hardness than silver and copper. It resists abrasion, collision, sweat and water, maintaining milky whiteness permanently without oxidation or peeling. The inner band is fully polished into smooth arc for skin-friendly fit. All raised carving edges are rounded to prevent snags and scratches, balancing gorgeous design and wearable comfort. Inspired by the poetic scene of deer wandering under moonlight, antlers symbolize freedom, blessing and vitality; the central porcelain stone stands for bright moon, meaning pure heart, freedom and smooth life. Extremely versatile, it matches Hanfu, Lolita, vintage dresses and knitwear for elegant ladies; it also complements casual suits and Chinese-style costumes, presenting aloof nobility on men. Most mass-produced metal deer jewelry has rigid cold lines, while hand-carved porcelain features exclusive textures for every single ring with high collectible value. Without colorful gemstones, its luxury entirely comes from porcelain texture and carving lines, balancing tenderness and retro magnificence. It works perfectly as daily ornament and holiday gift, locking wilderness moonlight and deer romance on fingertips with exclusive timeless charm.

Without gemstone stacking, its luxury comes entirely from porcelain texture and relief craftsmanship. It merges the grandeur of oriental mythical beasts with the unique tenderness of white porcelain. Ideal for those who pursue oriental heritage and prefer powerful niche styles, it reveals refined taste in daily life and becomes a visual focus at business meetings, parties and evening events. description: 三叶花瓣戒指（3D 打印款）完整说明 一: 项目主要特点 高雅自然的植物姿态： 戒指正面以三片舒展的鸢尾（或百合类）花瓣为设计核心，花瓣呈品字形向外绽放，微翘的边缘与凹陷的瓣心构筑出立体的有机曲面，极具优雅与浪漫氛围。 细腻指纹般的叶脉纹理： 如图中所示，花瓣内部与戒圈表面布满了顺着曲面起伏延伸的同心圆与等高线纹理，宛如天然植物的叶脉肌理，将现代 3D 打印的层纹之美展现得淋漓尽致。 极简流线一体化戒圈： 戒圈由下方自然向上分叉过渡为支撑花瓣的花茎，整体线条纤细优雅，一次性 3D 打印成型，结构轻巧且贴合手形。 魅惑高贵的紫色视觉： 采用了极具神秘感的哑光深紫色呈现，既带着轻奢复古的艺术气质，又能作为指尖最吸睛的色彩点缀。 二: 适用场景 & 适配人群 适用场景 日常精致/法式复古穿搭： 作为指尖的轻奢亮眼单品，完美适配法式优雅、小众设计师风、文艺优雅或早春浪漫系穿搭。 节日浪漫与闺蜜心意礼品： 鸢尾花象征着爱意、光明与优雅，非常适合作为生日、情人节或纪念日送给伴侣、闺蜜的暖心好礼。 桌面艺术微雕展示： 不佩戴时将其独立立于妆台或陈列盘中，优美的花朵造型宛如一座精致的极简植物雕塑。 适配人群 植物美学与花卉元素爱好者： 偏爱自然花草主题、钟情于线条柔美且富有灵动感配饰的时尚爱好者。 紫色与小众设计师饰品控： 偏爱高饱和度色彩、追求小众不易撞款且带有独特肌理质感的配饰收集者。 3D 打印精致模型玩家： 喜欢打印薄壁曲面、微缩有机雕塑以及热衷于尝试彩色/丝绸耗材的创客玩家。 三: 3D 打印设置（0.4mm 标准喷嘴通用参数） 为了确保三片花瓣悬空的边缘成型平整、花瓣内部叶脉纹理清晰锐利，建议参考以下切片参数： 层高（Layer Height）： 强烈建议设置为 0.08mm - 0.12mm。较细的层高能保证花瓣弯曲处的弧度平滑无台阶感，并完美还原微缩叶脉的细腻质感。 支撑设置（Support）： 建议开启 树状支撑（Tree Support） 。仅在倾斜延伸的花瓣下沿生成少许支撑，确保花瓣悬空部位打印不塌陷且易于拆除。 墙数量 / 外轮廓（Walls / Perimeters）： 3 - 4 层。充足的外墙厚度能确保纤细的花茎与薄花瓣在佩戴时具备足够的抗断裂强度。 填充率（Infill）： 推荐设置为 100%（实心打印）。实心填充能带来更好的结构刚性与更扎实的手感。 打印速度： 外部可见区域（Outer Wall）建议降速至 25-35 mm/s，确保薄花瓣边缘成型精致不拉丝。 四: 补充打印 & 组装建议 尺寸缩放与佩戴参考： 标准首饰佩戴款（按手指内径缩放）： 测量佩戴手指的直径后，在切片软件中等比例缩放模型内径，建议内径比实际手指直径大 0.3mm - 0.5mm，以确保佩戴体验顺畅舒适。 桌面小雕像（50-70mm）： 放大尺寸打印后可以作为桌面上极其吸睛的植物微雕摆件或戒指架。 耗材与色彩推荐： 魅惑深紫风（如图中效果）： 使用 哑光紫（Matte Purple）或薰衣草紫 PLA 耗材，呈现充满艺术画廊感的高级雕塑质感。 梦幻丝绸/珍珠风： 推荐使用 丝绸紫（Silk Purple）或珍珠白 耗材，光线照射在花瓣的波浪纹理上会产生迷人的光泽折射。 佩戴舒适度与安全优化： 花瓣尖端在打印成型后可能稍显利落，建议用细砂纸对尖端进行微小的圆角打磨，防止日常佩戴时勾挂衣物。 拆除支撑后，建议用 800 目以上的细砂纸将戒指内圈打磨光滑，使其贴合手指时更加温润亲肤。

description: Turn your own SVG design into a thin, customizable 3D-printed graphic for a shirt or other fabric project. Upload a closed SVG file, choose the final width and thickness, and generate a print-ready model directly in MakerWorld Parametric Model Maker. The design is automatically centered and resized while preserving its original proportions. Horizontal mirroring is enabled by default for transfer workflows that require the design to be reversed. Disable it if your application method does not require mirroring. Features: Upload your own closed SVG design Adjustable final width from 20 to 250 mm Adjustable thickness from 0.2 to 1.0 mm Optional horizontal mirroring Automatic centering and proportional scaling Flat, support-free geometry How to use: Upload a clean, closed SVG file. Set the desired final width. Select the design thickness. Keep mirroring enabled if required by your transfer method. Generate the model and inspect it carefully in your slicer. Test the material and transfer process on scrap fabric first. Known limitations: Separate SVG islands will print as separate pieces. Open paths, overlapping paths and excessive SVG canvas whitespace may produce unexpected results. Heat-transfer temperature, adhesion and wash durability depend on the filament, fabric and application method. No assembly required. Step-by-Step Guide: Step 1: Lay your clothing flat on a hard, sturdy table . (Do NOT use a soft ironing board). Step 2: Place your printed PLA name on the fabric exactly where you want it. Step 3: 🛑 CRITICAL WARNING: Cover the PLA text completely with a sheet of baking paper! NEVER let the hot metal of the iron directly touch the PLA , or you will ruin your iron! Step 4: Set your iron to Medium-High heat (Cotton/Linen setting, around 150-160°C). Turn OFF the steam function. Step 5: Press the iron down firmly over the baking paper for 10 to 15 seconds . (Do NOT rub or slide the iron, just press straight down with strong pressure). Step 6: Remove the iron. DO NOT PEEL THE PAPER YET! Wait about 1 minute for the clothing and PLA to completely cool down and harden. Once cool to the touch, gently peel away the baking paper. (💡 Pro Tip: If any edges aren't fully stuck down, place the baking paper back over it and press firmly for another 5 seconds.) 🧼 Washing Tips: It is machine washable! Turn your favorite design into a unique 3D T-shirt 👕🖨️ These thin and flexible 3D prints are designed to be heat-transferred directly onto fabric using a household iron. The result is a durable and eye-catching 3D design that combines modern 3D printing technology with fashion. Instructions 🛠️👕 Download the model and open it in Bambu Studio 💻 Print the model using the recommended settings and carefully remove it from the build plate. ⚠️ Handle with care — the model is extremely thin (approximately 0.3 mm) and may tear or deform if bent too aggressively. Prepare your ironing area: Place the T-shirt on an ironing board or a flat heat-resistant surface. Set your iron to a very high temperature (almost maximum heat, without steam) 🔥 Allow the iron to fully preheat before starting. Position the printed model on the desired area of the T-shirt and cover it with baking/parchment paper 📄 Apply firm pressure with the preheated iron for 15–20 seconds. For larger designs, move the iron slowly and evenly to ensure the entire model receives sufficient heat. Maintain consistent pressure throughout the process. ⏱️ Allow the area to cool for a few seconds, then carefully remove the paper. ✅ The model should remain attached to the fabric while the paper lifts away easily. (Optional) Turn the T-shirt inside out and iron the reverse side of the applied design for an additional 5–10 seconds to improve adhesion. 👕✨ Important ⚠️ Always use the iron at a very high temperature (near maximum setting) and with the steam function turned off. Insufficient heat or pressure may result in poor adhesion to the fabric. Test on a small area first if using delicate or heat-sensitive fabrics. Care Instructions 🧼 Wash garments at temperatures not exceeding 50°C (122°F). Turn the T-shirt inside out before washing whenever possible. Avoid bleach and aggressive washing programs. Do not tumble dry at high temperatures. ⚠️ Washing or drying at excessive temperatures may cause the 3D print to loosen or peel from the fabric over time.

Parametric Electronics Panel Generator Create fully customized front panels for electronics projects directly in MakerWorld’s Parametric Model Maker. This generator combines a configurable base plate, component-specific cutout presets, fan openings, mounting holes and optional labels in one single OpenSCAD file. It is designed for control panels, power supplies, workshop equipment, enclosures, test stations, model-making projects and other custom electronics applications. Customizable panel The base panel can be adjusted to fit the required enclosure or installation area. Available panel settings include: panel width and height panel thickness rounded corners upper edge chamfer optional raised border four optional mounting holes optional countersinks manual or automatic cutout arrangement The model is centered around the origin and has a completely flat underside for easy printing. Up to 10 configurable cutouts The panel supports up to ten independently configurable component positions. Each cutout can be: enabled or disabled positioned individually rotated freely arranged automatically in a grid combined with mounting holes combined with anti-rotation holes combined with side locking reliefs labeled separately Selecting None disables the corresponding cutout. Included cutout types The generator includes basic geometric openings as well as presets for common electronic components. Available types include: round hole slot rectangle rounded rectangle USB-A USB-C RJ45 toggle switch rocker switch potentiometer rotary encoder display standard fan sizes custom fan The component presets use different starting geometries and optional secondary openings. Manual dimensions can still be used when a specific component differs from the preset. Because component dimensions vary between manufacturers, the actual part should always be measured before printing the final panel. Fan cutouts and ventilation grills Fan cutouts include the central airflow area and the corresponding mounting-hole pattern. Available fan options include several standard sizes and a fully customizable fan type. Different ventilation styles can be selected: open circle cross radial slots honeycomb concentric rings The grill rotation, bar width, opening size and mounting-hole dimensions can be adjusted. Individual component labels Every cutout can receive its own text label. For each label, the following can be configured: label text engraved or raised style position above, below, left or right text size text depth or height distance from the component additional X and Y offset independent text rotation The label is positioned relative to the associated component and moves together with it when the cutout is repositioned. Typical labels include: POWER USB NETWORK DISPLAY FAN INPUT OUTPUT RESET VOLUME ON / OFF All component labels can also be disabled globally. Optional panel title A separate title can be added to the complete panel. The title can be placed at the top or bottom and can be either engraved or raised. Possible applications include: CONTROL PANEL POWER SUPPLY FAN CONTROLLER TEST STATION WORKSHOP CONTROL BATTERY MONITOR The title size, depth, edge distance, position and rotation can be adjusted independently. Automatic layout When automatic layout is enabled, all active cutouts are placed in a configurable grid. The user can define: number of columns horizontal spacing vertical spacing complete layout offset Individual cutout dimensions and rotations remain active, while their manual position values are ignored. Typical applications The generator is suitable for: electronics enclosures control panels bench power supplies workshop machines fan controllers test equipment Raspberry Pi and microcontroller projects audio equipment vehicle and camper installations robotics and model making custom switch and connector panels Printing The panel is designed to print with its flat rear side directly on the build plate. In this orientation: the chamfer faces upward countersinks face upward engraved labels remain visible raised labels are printed on top supports are normally not required For mechanically loaded panels, use a suitable material and sufficient wall thickness. Important note The included presets are intended as practical starting points. USB modules, RJ45 sockets, switches, displays and other components are not fully standardized between manufacturers. Always measure the actual component and verify: main opening dimensions mounting-hole spacing locking tabs panel thickness requirements required printing tolerance V2 includes XT60!

description: SIMPLE . FLYING . FUN Hummel RC is a simple and fun two-channel RC airplane designed for relaxed flights on a small field. Its modular construction is lightweight, durable and quick to print, with low material use and smooth, stable flight behavior. The adjustable wing position makes CG and pitch tuning easy. The model has no movable control surfaces: altitude is controlled by total motor thrust, while turns are performed through differential thrust between the two wing-mounted motors. Hummel RC continues the ideas of WingStar , COMET , Wespe , SkyStar and DragonFly in a compact and practical RC model made to fly often . 1 - Model Data Wingspan: 405 mm Length: 365 mm Wing chord: 60 mm Model mass (with RC receiver, battery and motors): 43 g. 2 - Equipment RC transmitter and receiver: 2 Channel 2.4G FX803 J3 ( Aliexpress link here ) Battery: 3.7v, 220 mAh, Molex 51005 connector ( Aliexpress link here ) Motors and Props: 2x716 Coreless motors with 2 props diam 46 mm ( Aliexpress link here ) 3 - Materials, Settings, Printing Model design created and tested using Bambu PLA Basi c. Use this material for best results. Do NOT use PLA Matte, especially for the wing parts. Printed parts may deform after removal from the Plate due to internal material strains after cooling. Use recommended print settings. Note: The print profile for A1 mini use slightly higher material flow coefficient (1.03 instead of 0.98). For reliable printing: Clean the printing Plate before printing. After printing, remove the Plate and let it cool for 3-4 minutes Do not remove parts while the Plate is hot. 4 - Model Assembly The model consists of 20 parts, as shown in the figure. 1 – Nose, 2 – PCB Mount, 3 – A-Beam (3pcs), 4 – B-Beam, 5 – Strut (2pcs), 6 – Sting, 7 – Tail, 8 – Fin, 9 – Central Bracket, 10 – Dual-pin, 11 – Right Wing, 12 – Left Wing , 13 – Right Big Rib, 14 – Left Big Rib, 15 – Small Rib (2pcs), 16 – Gear mount, 17 – Gear Strut (2pcs), 18 – Wheel (2pcs), 19 – Pin (2pcs), 20 – BHCS Screw M2 x 4 mm (4 pcs). Note : RC Receiver, Engines, props are not shown. The following assembly steps are shown without the electronic components installed. It is recommended to review them before installing the motors and electronics. Use cyanoacrylate glue where specifically indicated. Assemble the tail unit and fuselage as shown. Assemble the wing as shown in the figure. Use Dual-pin to fix wings. After installing and fixing the wing surfaces, install Big Ribs (13, 14) on both sides. Finally, install the Ribs (15) on both sides. Wing assembly completed. To install the wing on the fuselage, pull the fuselage beam through predefined guide points on the wing Central Bracket, as shown in the picture. A slight pushing force may be gently applied if needed. Assemble landing gear unit as shown on Figure. Install landing gear on Fuselage. To fix finally the wing and landing gear position the M2x4 screws to be installed. Do not fix wing and gear assembly finally on this step! 4.1 - Electronic Components Installation Install RC transmitter PCB on bracket (2). Finally, connect the motors to the receiver board as shown in the illustration. Before final assembly, make sure the motors rotate in opposite directions. For easier assembly and adjustment, the wires should be approximately 130 mm long. The wires are preferable to route through the rib. To install the motor in the rib, gently press it into place and slide it slightly forward until there is no gap. To prevent the motor from rotating during operation, secure it with a small piece of adhesive tape, as shown in the illustration. Install the ribs with the motors onto the wing as shown in the illustration. The motors must be positioned on the outer side of each rib. Install the wing onto the lower beam, approximately at the middle of the span. Then route the motor wires behind the lower beam and around the upper beam in a figure-eight pattern, as shown in the illustration. This routing keeps the wires secure while still allowing the wing position to be adjusted. Only after routing the wires, install the landing gear, followed by the receiver bracket (2). Install the nose part (1) and secure it with screw (20). Install the battery and hold it in place with a suitable rubber band, as shown on picture. The model assembly is now complete. 4.2 - Balancing Perform the pre-flight balancing check with the battery installed. Place the model on a Balancing Stand ( model link here ) using the designated balance points on the wing. The model should remain level or tip slightly nose-down. Fix finally the screws (20) of wing assembly and gear bracket. 5 - Model Flight Launch the model outdoors in calm weather or slight breeze conditions. Recommended wind speed: up to 5 km/h (≈1.4 m/s, ≈2.7 knots) . Always launch the model directly into the wind . Model initially pre-balanced during assembly. Launch the model applying full throttle with a gentle horizontal push. If the model dives strongly, then: Move the wing slightly forward, OR bend the elevator slightly upward. If the model pitches up or stalls, first try reducing the flight speed. If flight speed reduction does not help, then: Move the wing slightly backward, OR bend the elevator slightly downward. Happy Flights and Smooth Landings!

Most 3D-printed phone docks with "speakers" sound pretty bad. They usually just punch a straight, hollow cone into a block of plastic, which traps the low frequencies and makes your phone sound like it’s playing out of a tin can. I wanted a dock that actually worked, and I wanted it to look like a piece of high-end vintage audio gear on my desk. The Monolith hides a mathematically calculated, 100mm exponential horn inside a solid, minimalist block. Instead of just bouncing sound forward, the internal sweep acts as a true acoustic transformer—just like an old-school gramophone. It physically amplifies the volume and actually brings back the warmth and bass of your phone's speaker without using any electricity. Because phone cases make finding a good dock impossible, I built this to be fully parametric in MakerLab. There's pre-sets for different phones with and without phone cases and I also allow for custom measurements. Just hit the Customize button . Features Fits Your Exact Phone Setup: No more wobbly phones or slots that are too tight. Pick your phone model from the dropdown, then choose your case type (Bare Phone, Slim Case, or Heavy Duty Armor). The customizer calculates the exact tolerances so your phone slides in perfectly. Audiophile vs. Charging Mode: By default, the acoustic chamber is sealed airtight for maximum volume. But if you’d rather use this as an overnight charging dock, just check the "Enable Charging Channel" box. It routes a massive 16mm internal tunnel that easily swallows thick, braided USB-C cables. Supported Device Presets The Monolith's customizer includes precise base dimensions (Width x Thickness) for the following devices. You can select your exact phone model and then pair it with your case type for a perfect fit. Apple iPhone 17 Series iPhone 17 Pro Max: 77.6 mm x 8.3 mm iPhone 17 Pro: 71.5 mm x 8.3 mm iPhone 17: 71.5 mm x 8.0 mm iPhone Air: 74.7 mm x 5.6 mm Apple iPhone 16 Series iPhone 16 Pro Max: 77.6 mm x 8.25 mm iPhone 16 Pro: 71.5 mm x 8.25 mm iPhone 16: 71.6 mm x 7.8 mm Apple iPhone 15 Series iPhone 15 Pro Max: 76.7 mm x 8.25 mm iPhone 15 Pro: 70.6 mm x 8.25 mm iPhone 15: 71.6 mm x 7.8 mm Google Pixel Series (Note: All Pixel presets automatically generate an additional 2.5mm of pocket depth to allow the camera visor to sit flush without snagging). Pixel 10 Pro XL: 76.6 mm x 8.5 mm Pixel 10: 72.2 mm x 8.5 mm Pixel 9 Pro XL: 76.6 mm x 8.5 mm Pixel 9 Pro: 72.0 mm x 8.5 mm Pixel 9: 72.0 mm x 8.5 mm Samsung Galaxy Series Galaxy S26 Ultra: 79.0 mm x 8.6 mm Custom Devices Don't see your phone? Select the Custom option in the dropdown and manually enter your phone's width and thickness! Case Allowances Once you select your phone model, choose your case style. The generator automatically adds the necessary tolerances to your phone's base dimensions: Bare Phone: Adds +0.5 mm clearance for a snug, scratch-free fit. Slim Case: Adds +5.0 mm clearance for standard silicone and leather cases. Heavy Duty Armor: Adds +12.0 mm clearance for rugged, multi-layer cases. Print Instructions (Read Before Slicing!) Supports: OFF. Seriously, do not use supports. If you do, the slicer will fill the internal acoustic chamber with grid plastic, and you will never get it out. The printer will bridge the internal gaps on its own. Infill: 10% Rectilinear is fine. Walls: 2 walls min but 3 walls is default (better acoustics). Denser plastic means less sound bleeds through the sides, forcing all the audio energy out the front bell. Drop a make if you print one, and let me know how it sounds!

description: FlightScnr Pi A flight tracker for Raspberry Pi built for the Waveshare 4in touch display. The on-device UI is modeled after my other project, FlightScnr : dark radar aesthetic, animated sweep, map tiles, and gesture navigation. A built-in web portal configures everything from your phone or laptop on the same network. What it does FlightScnr Pi shows live aircraft around your pre set location on a circular radar, with rich flight details when you tap a plane. It combines FlightRadar24 (FR24) , live positions from adsb.fi (free cloud feed — no local ADS-B dongle), Tomorrow.io weather , and optional AirLabs schedule data. Settings, API keys, tracking, and updates are managed through a local web portal. No SSH required for day-to-day use. Round touch display The UI is designed for a 4in round LCD with touch (default layout: 720x720 ). Featured in this Tom's Hardware article . 2.5" SSD Dock + Cartridge System This Collection includes model files for: Inner / Outer Case for the SSD Cartridge (with cutouts for printed artworks) BigDock: Sturdy dock with ball bearings to guide the cartridges in from the front SmallDock: Small, low-profile, simple dock. Cartridge insertion from the top. Blank front plates for both dock versions for your own customization. These docks have been designed with 1 specific USB-to-SATA Adapter in mind: Sabrent (EC-SSHD) Disclaimer SATA data and power connectors are typically rated for 50 to 500 insertion cycles (mating cycles) before pin degradation. Always insert carefully without needing much force. Assembly Notes Cartridges: Because of manufacturing tolerances for SSDs, you might have to put some thin tape on the SSDs before inserting them into the Case. Just make it tight enough of a fit so that the SSDs wont slide out of the case when unplugging from the Dock. The Handle has through holes for screwing in the M3x6 screws to secure the outer case to the inner case. I recommend gluing or double-sided tape the “top end” of the outer casing to the inner casing. Big Dock: Put the Dock into the base first, then slide the Adapter in, and only then screw the adapter cover on. If you put the adapter in the dock first, you won't be able to put the dock into the base. The optional slide guard needs to be glued on or stuck on with thin double-sided tape. The FrontPlate can also be glued on or stuck on with thin double-sided tape. The Bearing Pins is just friction fit to allow easier removal of bearings. They slide in from the bottom. The Dock itself should fit nicely into the base. If it's too lose, feel free to glue down or use double-sided tape. Alle Abmessungen werden in Millimetern angegeben und können direkt vor der Erstellung des Modells verändert werden. Enthalten sind: ein gerader Rohradapter zum Vergrößern oder Reduzieren eines Durchmessers ein Rohrwinkel mit frei einstellbarem Winkel eine U-förmige Rohrbefestigung für die Wand Die Modelle eignen sich unter anderem für Werkstattprojekte, Absaugungen, Belüftungen, Kabeldurchführungen, Modellbau und individuelle Rohrinstallationen. 1. Rohradapter / Reduzierstück mit 45°-Übergang Der Rohradapter verbindet zwei unterschiedliche Rohrdurchmesser miteinander. Zwischen den beiden geraden Rohrabschnitten befindet sich ein automatisch berechneter, konischer Übergang mit einer Flankensteigung von 45° . Der Adapter kann sowohl als Reduzierstück als auch als Vergrößerungsstück verwendet werden. Sind beide Durchmesser identisch, entsteht automatisch ein gerades Rohrstück. Einstellbare Parameter diameter_1 – Außendurchmesser der ersten Seite diameter_2 – Außendurchmesser der zweiten Seite thickness – Wandstärke des Adapters length – Länge jedes geraden Rohrabschnitts bis zum 45°-Übergang Die Länge des konischen Übergangs wird automatisch anhand der beiden Durchmesser berechnet. Wichtig diameter_1 und diameter_2 beziehen sich auf die Außendurchmesser des gedruckten Adapters . Die jeweiligen Innendurchmesser ergeben sich aus: Innendurchmesser = Außendurchmesser − 2 × Wandstärke Der Begriff „45°“ beschreibt hier den konischen Übergang zwischen den Durchmessern und nicht eine Richtungsänderung des Rohres. Geeignet für Rohrreduzierungen und Rohrerweiterungen Absaug- und Lüftungsleitungen Schlauch- und Geräteanschlüsse Werkstattadapter individuelle Übergangsstücke 2. Parametrischer Rohrwinkel Das zweite Modell erzeugt ein gebogenes, hohles Rohrstück mit frei einstellbarer Richtungsänderung. Dadurch können beispielsweise 30°-, 45°-, 60°- oder 90°-Winkel erstellt werden. Auf beiden Seiten des Bogens befindet sich ein gerader Rohrabschnitt mit identischer Länge. Einstellbare Parameter diameter – Außendurchmesser des Rohrwinkels thickness – Wandstärke des Rohrwinkels length – gerade Rohrlänge je Seite, gemessen ab dem Bogen angle – gewünschte Richtungsänderung in Grad Der Biegeradius wird automatisch passend zum eingestellten Rohrdurchmesser erzeugt. Wichtig diameter bezeichnet den Außendurchmesser des gedruckten Rohrwinkels . Der Innendurchmesser ergibt sich aus: Innendurchmesser = diameter − 2 × thickness Der Parameter length gilt für beide Seiten einzeln. Bei einer Einstellung von 30 mm besitzt der Winkel daher vor und nach dem Bogen jeweils einen geraden Rohrabschnitt von 30 mm. Geeignet für Rohrleitungen mit individuellen Winkeln Absaug- und Belüftungssysteme Kabel- oder Schlauchführungen Modellbau Prototypen und Sonderlösungen 3. Rohrbefestigung für die Wand Das dritte Modell ist eine U- beziehungsweise Omega-förmige Rohrhalterung. Das Rohr wird vom gebogenen Bereich umschlossen, während die beiden nach außen umgeklappten Enden an einer Wand oder einer anderen ebenen Fläche befestigt werden können. In den beiden Befestigungslaschen befinden sich Schraublöcher. Einstellbare Parameter diameter – Außendurchmesser des zu befestigenden Rohres thickness – Materialstärke der Halterung width – Breite der Halterung entlang des Rohres Die Länge der beiden Befestigungslaschen wird automatisch an den Rohrdurchmesser angepasst. Passung und Schraublöcher Das Modell besitzt standardmäßig ein radiales Spiel von ungefähr 0,4 mm . Dadurch ist der Innendurchmesser der Halterung etwa 0,8 mm größer als der eingestellte Rohrdurchmesser. Für wärmere Umgebungen, Werkstätten oder Bereiche mit höherer mechanischer Belastung ist PETG, ASA oder ein vergleichbar widerstandsfähiges Material meist besser geeignet. model_name: Rope Paracord Ratchet Tensioner Outdoor Tie-Down
description: A fully 3D-printed rope ratchet tensioner that tightens your line one satisfying click at a time, and releases with a thumb press. No knots, no fiddling, no metal ratchet wheel to source. Pull the cord, let the ratchet do the holding, and dial in tension with one hand. Inspired by the little aluminum rope-tensioner pulleys you see on tent guylines and grow-light hangers, but reimagined so almost everything comes off your printer . The grip comes from the cord wrapping the knurled wheel (capstan effect) combined with a directional ratchet that only lets the wheel turn one way. Honest performance - Read this first I test my functional models to failure and I tell you the real numbers, not marketing ones. Recommended working load: 3–4 kg (or 20+ kg with a backup knot, read below). Slip point observed in my tests: 5–7 kg , depending on the cord. It does not break under load, when overloaded, the cord slips on the wheel rather than the part snapping. The limiting factor is grip between cord and printed wheel , not the mechanism (the ratchet and clicker themselves hold far more). A steel wheel like the commercial versions grips harder, a printed wheel can't fully match that, and that's the honest trade-off of an all-printed design. Tip to squeeze out more grip: printing the wheel in a slightly abrasive or matte/porous filament increases surface friction and can push the slip point higher. Smooth glossy filament grips the least. Tension is cord-dependent, different cord material, diameter and sheath change the grip. Always test with your own cord before trusting a load. Backup stopper knot — a big safety margin Here's the trick that changes the game for the rare high-load moment: tie a simple stopper knot on the tail (the free end running through). If the cord ever starts to slip, the knot jams against the tensioner and can't pass, and from that point the load is carried by the structure of the part , not by friction grip. In my own testing, with a backup knot I pulled it to 20 kg one-handed with zero drama, and that was the limit of what I could safely pull by hand, not the limit of the part. Beyond that it's the shell and anchor taking the load, and there's clearly more headroom. Real-world use: tensioning a line with a backup stopper knot on the tail for extra security. With a backup stopper knot, it held 20+ kg in hand-testing without failure Where it works well (≈3–4 kg working) Tent and tarp guylines - the core use Tarp ridgelines , camp clotheslines, drying lines Hanging grow lights, lanterns, camp lights (1–3 kg) - the classic rope-ratchet job Hanging planters, bird feeders / birdhouses Backpack compression and lashing light gear Kayak / canoe deck rigging for light gear Tensioning banners, bunting, light signs, shade cloth, awnings Where NOT to use it (please respect this) ❌ Climbing or anything a person hangs from, never. This is not safety equipment. ❌ Hammock body (80–150 kg). Tarp suspension over a hammock is fine; the hammock itself is not. ❌ Primary vehicle / roof cargo tie-down. Use as a light positioning aid only, never as the load-bearing restraint. ❌ Leash or tie-out for medium/large dogs, a single lunge exceeds the working load instantly. ❌ Anything overhead where a drop could injure someone or damage something. Print settings Layer height: 0.16 mm, or adaptive (adaptive is set in the included profile), this matters for the printed closure-screw threads to come out clean. Supports: optional , only for the retention-screw holes . The rest prints support-free. Material: PETG recommended for outdoor UV/heat durability; PLA is fine for indoor / light use. Preparing the torsion spring The spring needs a quick manual tweak (real photos included in the model gallery): Cut one leg to ~5 mm . Keep the other leg at ~10 mm and bend a 90° angle at the end, like this: That's it, no special tools, just cutters and pliers. Assembly 1. Build the wheel (4 parts). The wheel is split into four pieces so each prints cleanly: the bottom piece that seats into the base shell, the first knurled half of the wheel, the second knurled half, these two slide together on the central hex pin , the clicker gear on top. Stack all four onto the M2.5 SHCS and secure with the M2.5 hex nut . 2. Wrap the cord. Route the cord around the assembled wheel. 3. Seat it. Place the wheel assembly into the base shell . 4. Add the pawl + spring. Insert the pawl together with the prepared torsion spring, as shown in the gallery. 5. Close it up. Fit the cover , then drive the 4 × M2 closure screws . 6. Anchor point. Finally insert the M3 × 14 screw (with its M3 nut) — this is where the carabiner clips on. Cord notes Tested with 3 mm Nylon Paracord 425 and 4 mm cord, results were very similar between the two. Thicker cord may grip better but I didn't have any on hand to test. If you try thicker or different cord, please leave feedback in the comments, I'll collect real numbers and add a grip table. description: LoopLoom - a fully 3D printable tablet weaving loom. The goal: Long warps. Small footprint. No tools. There's no question about it: A nice wooden loom is fun to use and looks great. But it also takes up quite a bit of space, isn't exactly light, and isn't cheap either. For beginners or when you're on the go: A printable loom would be just the thing! The facts: 2,5 meter (100 inch) warp. Adjustable waving angle. Printable on 256mm bed size. The three adjustable extensions allow you to stretch up to 2.5 meters of ribbon—realistically, you can weave braids about 2 meters long. Using the two front extensions, you can adjust the angle to be steeper or flatter: You can adjust the thread tension on all three extensions. On the left side of each extension, there is a screw that you can use to loosen or tighten it. To secure the thread at the beginning, simply tie a knot in the cord and pull it through the slot from the right: If you're used to doing it this way with another frame (e.g., an "Ashford inkle loom"), you can also screw a 3mm screw into the existing hole and wrap the thread around it. When you want to store the LoopLoom, you can loosen the screw that secures the base and pull the base out. It then snaps into place—with a click—in the center of the frame, making the LoopLoom even more portable: That's exactly how the frame with the foot comes out of your printer. Apply a little pressure to the foot to remove it, slide it onto the frame from the back (there's a slot in the frame for this), and secure it with the screw that matches the frame's color: The print: 2 plates, 2 colors. Since the frame is very large, it tends to warp during printing. I’ve therefore made a few optimizations, which you can read about here . In my enclosed printers (P1S and X1C), this allows me to print the frame perfectly flat—which is important for the extensions to work properly. Either use my print profile or slice it yourself: Start with a 0.16 mm profile as a base, set the infill to 10% gyroid, and adjust the number of walls for the different parts: Cover caps: 2 Screws, base: 3 Frame: 4 Slide-outs: 5 Slide-out 3—the longest one—should be as sturdy as possible: 7 walls and 50% infill. Although I usually print with engineering filaments, plain PLA is the best choice here because stiffness is key. If you have PLA-CF, you can use it for the extensions (i.e., for Plate 2), but it’s not necessary. Here, I printed the first plate in “PLA matte dark brown” and the second in “PLA matte dark chocolate brown”: Some of the pieces on Plate 2 have changed since the photo was taken, and a shuttle has been added: If you prefer weaving shuttles that are a little bigger and fit better in your hand, here’s another model I made. If you'd prefer the foot to be a little heavier or thicker (for example, so you can wedge it between your legs on the sofa more easily), just place the foot on a suitable wooden board. Trace around it and cut it out. Screw the foot onto the board—there are already 4 holes for countersunk screws. I'll take some photos of this soon. I hope you have a lot of fun weaving—if so, I'd love to see a photo of the border, but I'd also appreciate a like, a good review, or a boost! And of course, feel free to ask questions if things aren't working out as they should. If you'd like to sell the loom, please contact me. Update 19.07.2026 I made a slight modification to slide 3; it now has a height-adjustable foot. This prevents the loom from wobbling when the slide bends upward slightly due to thread tension. You can easily reprint and replace the slide.

description: Four motors - 16.1 km/h. The Rebel 787-C1 is a high-performance 1:24 scale indoor/outdoor micro racer designed for builders who want uncompromising mechanical performance from a CyberBrick build. Inspired by the legendary four-rotor endurance race cars of the 1990s, it translates that iconic engineering into a synchronized quad-motor powertrain . ---------------------------------------------------------- 📋 Technical specifications: Scale: 1:24 Drive: RWD Motors: 4 Top speed: 16.1 km/h Weight: 225 g (battery included) Weight distribution: 47% front - 53% rear Print time: ~7 hours (single color) Assembly: < 30 minutes ---------------------------------------------------------- 🏁 Why print this Lightning-Fast Single Color Print: A complete single-color layout prints in just around 7 hours . A1 Mini Friendly: E verything fits comfortably on a single 180 × 180 mm build plate. Pure Living Room Performance: With a measured top speed of 16.1 km/h , this isn't just a display model—it handles beautifully and is genuinely fun to drive indoors or on smooth outdoor surfaces. An Accessible Tribute: One of the easiest and most accessible ways to own a fully functional RC version of this endurance racing legend. ---------------------------------------------------------- ⏱️ Friction-Free Print, Quick Assembly (Under 30 Mins), video guided firmware flashing Never set up RC electronics before? No stress. The step-by-step PDF guide holds your hand through the entire mechanical build, and the video tutorial walks you through step by step flashing the firmware and binding your controller. You'll comfortably go from a box of printed parts to a fully functional racer—zero guesswork required. When you already assembled the car, just CLICK HERE for the step by step video guide on how to flash the firmware ---------------------------------------------------------- 🛒 Support This Project (At Zero Cost To You!) If you're purchasing the required CyberBrick hardware or filament anyway, consider ordering through the Bill of Materials on this page. It doesn't cost you anything extra, and the small commission helps fund future projects. Thank you! ---------------------------------------------------------- 🤓 The Nerd Zone ( Engineering Highlights) Quad-Motor "4-Rotor" Power: Two synchronized core logic boards drive four independent rear motors, delivering explosive acceleration and a scale-speed experience worthy of its legendary inspiration. True Monocoque Design: The body is the chassis. By engineering structural screw points directly into the body lines, the car sheds 25 grams of dead weight, resulting in a featherweight 225g (including the battery) . True Mechanical Differential & Low-Friction Drivetrain: A custom-designed open differential, paired with low-friction POM gears and precision steel pins, minimizes drivetrain losses for smooth, efficient power delivery. Pan-Car Style Rear Suspension: The rear motor pod is integrated into a flexible pan-car-style suspension that allows the drivetrain to articulate independently of the chassis. This helps all four tires stay planted over uneven surfaces, improving grip and stability at high speed. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ❓ Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) Q: What extra hardware do I need if I already have the Cyberbrick Ultimate Hardware Kit ZK003? A: In this case You only need two additional items to complete the build, direct links can be found in the BOM: 1x Power Splitter Cable (2-Pin XH2.54 Male to Dual XH2.54 Female) 1x Micro Steel Bearings – EA004 Q: Which version of the CyberBrick Official Standard Remote should I print? A: I strongly recommend printing the Lithium Battery Version Standard Remote of the official remote for the best stability and performance: If you already own the Cyberbrick Ultimate Hardware Kit ZK003: You already have the extra Li-ion battery included for the Remote! If you are buying hardware now: A Li-ion Battery is listed in the BOM widget, this is optional. Keep it checked in for the best remote performance, or uncheck it to save ~ €4.59 if you plan to build the standard AAA remote. If you decide to not buy the optional Li-ion battery and build the AAA remote: If you experience unexpected remote shut-offs, simply plug a USB-C phone charger or power bank directly into the remote board while driving for a stable power supply. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Clean The Buildplate Before print, clean the buildplate thoroughly by hot water and liquid soap (NOT IPA!!!) There are a lots of parts on a single buildplate in this model (especially the single color profile), and cleaning the plate can prevent possible print failures.

description: I picked up embroidery this year and every hoop I bought had the same problem: a metal screw sticking out of the edge, right where my thread wants to travel. It snagged on every pass. So I went looking for a hoop without one. Amazon, Etsy, the craft store. It does not exist. Spring hoops have fixed tension. Press-fit hoops do not adjust. Every adjustable hoop on earth puts the screw on the edge. So I moved it. On this hoop the entire tension mechanism lives in a small bridge behind the frame. The outside edge is completely smooth. You still tighten it clockwise like any hoop, you still get fine control (about 3 turns per millimeter), but there is nothing for your thread to catch on. Ever. Four oval sizes (60x80 up to 140x200 mm). All the hardware tucks completely inside. Prints without supports. Round sizes coming soon. WHAT YOU NEED PER HOOP (not included, standard hardware-store parts): 1x M4x30 socket head cap screw 2x M4 hex nuts a 3mm allen key (for assembly only) Any brand works, metric sizes are standard. Use socket head cap screws and plain hex nuts, not button-head screws and not nylon lock nuts. Always print knobs two at at least .16 high quality, .12mm is best PRINT: No supports, anywhere. Do not rotate parts. PETG recommended for inner rings (they flex when you mount fabric). 0.2mm rings, 0.12mm knobs. Snap the mouse ears off the knob after printing. Fully printed system to make plaster moulds. This produces a 3-part mould to cast a mini cauldron and lid This print has been scaled to 112% to account for clay shrinkage, which should give a final ornament size of 6cm diameter with most casting slips. If you want it smaller/larger than 6cm, scale every piece of the print. This design has a lid at one end and the cauldron at the other. You should be able to cast both at the same time (ish) by casting one end first, then casting the second while the slip is fully draining out the first. Because of the double ended design, this printed model is particularly difficult to demould from the plaster , and I've added several extra slots for extra flexibility (with extra caps to cover them while casting plaster). The more you sand/smooth your print and the better your release agent, the easier the process will be, but I wouldn't recommend this mould as a first project! With any fully 3D printed mould, you’ll benefit from using a release agent on the base plate surface. I use a generic mouldmaker’s soap, but any product designed for plaster release should be fine. It needs around 375ml of plaster, and you can calculate the weight of water and plaster needed with this tool: Plaster Calculator You can get a much better cast surface, even if your plaster mix is full of air bubbles, by using a paintbrush to dislodge any trapped air from the surface. I would suggest that you pour plaster until the ornament surface is covered but it isn’t completely full, then get a relatively small paintbrush and move it around in the plaster so that you’re brushing all of the details on the base plate surface. This will dislodge air bubbles, and once dislodged they’ll float upwards. Once you’ve finished this, pour in the rest of the plaster. If you manage to avoid adding more air as you do it (just brush gently), you’ll eventually remove all the bubbles from the surface and get a perfect cast. This uses the updated 3 part mould design, which is compatible with other updated 3 part moulds but not the original ornament moulds. This new design has slots added to the back to allow the mould to bend slightly when releasing the plaster, making the process much easier. This version has an additional larger slot in the print with a removable insert to stop plaster from leaking during casting. Remove the insert once you're ready to demould the plaster, then the added flexibility will allow the print to pop right off

Microgroove turns the $30 M5Stack Cardputer-ADV into a four-track groovebox: three synth tracks (each switchable between a mono 303-style voice with slide & accent, and 3-voice polyphony for chords), eight drum lanes of 808/909 synthesis or sample playback, live mic sampling, and resampling of its own output. This listing is the shell and keycap label system that makes it playable — the free, open-source firmware lives on GitHub: https://github.com/matoslav/MicroGroove It fits the M5Stack Cardputer- ADV specifically. The screen, USB-C port, and headphone jack all stay fully accessible after the swap. Printing Print with a 0.2 mm nozzle (strongly recommended). A 0.4 mm nozzle works, but the fine label text won't come out clean. The parts: Top + label top — the two-piece face. The label top is multi-color (blue / red / white). Keys — the keycaps, also multi-color. Bottom — optional. Table stand and box with instructions — optional extras. The label top and keys need a multi-color setup (AMS / multi-material or manual filament swaps). If you only print in one color, you'll still get a working shell, just without the colored labels. Assembly Glue the top and the label top together, slide in the keys, and swap the assembly for the original top your Cardputer-ADV came with. Two screws hold it in place — gluing the two face pieces matters because without it the edges lift. What the firmware does Three acid synth voices — saw/square/tri/sine plus 16 wavetables through a resonant 303 filter. Flip any track from mono squelch to 3-voice chords. Eight drum lanes — 808 and 909 synthesis or your own samples, side by side. Tune, decay, and choke each one. Sample the room — hold one key, watch the level meter, release. It's already playing on a lane. Resample yourself — bounce the live mix onto a pad and build the next layer on top. Sequence and arrange — 8 patterns of 16 steps, clone with a hold, chain up to 64 into a full song. Ready to play out of the box — the SD image on GitHub ships a five-pattern demo track and a CC0 sample pack.

description: Inspired by the public domain Spiral Yarn Bowl on thingiverse but modelled from scratch in fusion 360 and tested on an A1 mini and A1. This was a really “fun” project in fusion learning to figure out sprial design. (Or rather not so fun at times!). The main goal was to max out the print size on the A1, keeping walls reasonably thin to avoid filament waste, make sure its well filleted and must incorporate a handle. There were a lot of failures initially, I think I ended up on Version 3 before I got one with all parts printing cleanly! However I have learnt loads, particularly about printing overhangs and max angles to prevent support being needed on the curves of the bowl. I did try to have a collapsing handle but that just wasn't possible on this set, maybe on a different design in the future. This version now has fixed handle or hanging loops so the knitters/crotchet users can knit their own matching handle. If anyone needs a bowl without the slots do let me know but these are big bowls so moving them easily was one of the criteria. I needed three for mum and friends so I have designed four different versions with slightly different designs which I will post up in the next day or so. This is first one which is plain apart from the yarn guide and the needle holes. All bowls have two profiles, maxed out on the A1 mini build plate, and maxed out on the A1 build plate. Both versions print successfully so sizing up or down should print properly if you need an in between size. Highly recommend multicolour filament for these-comes out gorgeous. These were tested in Jayo dual colour matte PLA.

description: I designed this to help build my grip and forearm strength. It’s probably over engineered but I want something that would look good next to my other gym equipment. I printed mine in PETG, but PLA would also work. You’ll need a length of Ø5mm rope and two BT3x25 SHCS Self Tapping Screws (AA112). Tie a knot at one end of the rope and place into the slot in the inner core. I put a couple of drops of super glue on the knot to ensure it won’t come loose once weights are attached. Then it’s just a matter of sliding the rope guides and handles on. The handles need to be secured in place with the two self-tapping screws. You could use the fuzzy skin setting on the handles, but I like the smooth look and feel of the ribbed handles as they are. Cut the rope to size and use a sliding knot to secure the weight attachment. A sliding knot allows you to add or remove weights easily depending on your work out goals. The VORTEX 2 Tornado Probe (often referred to as a Tornado Pod) is a rugged, rapidly deployable ground instrument used in the Vortex 2 severe weather project to measure the core flow and structural characteristics of tornadoes at ground level. Key Characteristics: Design: A 1-meter (approx. 3.3 ft) tall instrument tower anchored by a heavy, flat base, allowing it to withstand extreme winds without being easily overturned. Instrumentation: Equipped with specialized anemometers and sensors to measure high-resolution wind speed, wind direction, temperature, and atmospheric pressure. Deployment: Mobile field teams rapidly positioned the probes on the ground in the direct path or immediate vicinity of an advancing tornado to gather data from inside the core flow. Scientific Purpose: The primary goal was to capture "ground truth" atmospheric data in the crucial zone where tornadoes develop to understand why and how tornadogenesis occurs. Probes provided critical near-surface data to correlate storm rotation with temperature, humidity, and wind fields. This model took me lot of time to complete, hope you enjoy it!
